experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an open-air sunrise yoga session overlooking the lush Campuhan valley, followed by a peaceful walk along the ridge trail. The cool morning air and stunning green landscape make this a deeply restorative experience. On rainy days, many local studios in Ubud offer indoor classes with the same instructors.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Walk & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner or intermediate surf lesson in the late afternoon when the heat subsides, then enjoy a leisurely sunset stroll along Seminyak's golden shoreline. Surf schools provide all equipment. If weather turns, opt for an indoor surf theory or ocean safety workshop offered by the same schools.

experiences.name: Traditional Balinese Cooking Class
experiences.description: Spend a midday session indoors learning to prepare authentic Balinese dishes such as nasi goreng, satay lilit, and black rice pudding. Classes typically include a morning market visit at dawn to source fresh ingredients, keeping you cool during the hottest part of the day. A perfect indoor alternative during rain or peak heat.
experiences.best_time_of_day: morning market visit (7:00 AM), cooking session (10:00 AM–1:00 PM)

experiences.name: Tirta Empul Temple Purification Ritual
experiences.description: Visit the sacred Tirta Empul water temple at dawn before crowds arrive and witness or participate in the traditional Hindu purification bathing ritual in the holy spring pools. The temple's covered pavilions provide shelter from rain, making this a reliable cultural experience in any weather.

experiences.name: Yin Yoga & Sound Healing Retreat Day
experiences.description: Spend a full morning at one of Ubud's renowned wellness centers enjoying a yin yoga class followed by a traditional Balinese sound healing session using singing bowls and gamelan instruments. Entirely indoors and air-conditioned, this is an ideal midday or rainy-day activity that aligns perfectly with yoga interests and Bali's spiritual culture.
